"}</script>

<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-01" data-backdrop="media/big-air-distant.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-01-backdrop"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-01-text-0">PERSONĪGS STĀSTS · 2026</div><div class="flex" style="align-items:center"><div class="half"><h1 class="big" data-edit-id="slide-01-text-1">11 gadi<br><span class="accent">dzenoties</span><br>pēc vēja.</h1><p class="sub" data-edit-id="slide-01-text-2">Kaitsērfings — no nejaušas tikšanās pludmalē līdz 15 metru lēcieniem.</p><div class="bottom"><span class="pill" data-edit-id="slide-01-text-3">20 min</span><span class="pill" data-edit-id="slide-01-text-4">Kitesurfing / Big Air</span></div></div><div class="half photo" data-fit="contain" data-img="custom/slide-01-img-0.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-01-img-0"><strong>SACENSĪBU DIENA</strong><span>Sākuma foto</span></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-02" data-hide="0"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-02-text-0">01 / PAMATI</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-02-text-1">Kas ir <span class="accent">kaitsērfings?</span></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half"><p class="quote" data-edit-id="slide-02-text-2">Vējš ir motors.<br>Kaits ir spārns.<br>Ūdens ir trase.</p><p class="sub" data-edit-id="slide-02-text-3">Braukšana ar dēli pa ūdeni, izmantojot vadāma pūķa radīto vilkmi.</p><p class="mini" data-edit-id="slide-02-text-4">Kaits, dēlis, vadības stienis un cilvēks — vienas sistēmas daļas.</p></div><div class="half photo feature-photo" data-img="media/intro-overview.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-02-img-0"><strong>BRAUCĒJS · DĒLIS · KAITS</strong><span>Mans kaitsērfinga arhīvs</span></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-03"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-03-text-0">02 / ĪSA VĒSTURE</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-03-text-1">Salīdzinoši <span class="accent">jauns</span> sporta veids.</h2><div class="history-split"><div><div class="timeline" style="margin-top:18px"><div><b>1984</b><p data-edit-id="slide-03-text-2">Brāļi Legaignoux izstrādā piepūšama kaita konstrukciju.</p></div><div><b>1997</b><p data-edit-id="slide-03-text-3">Wipika — viens no mūsdienu kaitu attīstības pagrieziena punktiem.</p></div><div><b>2000+</b><p data-edit-id="slide-03-text-4">Strauji attīstās inventārs, drošība un sporta disciplīnas.</p></div><div><b>2015</b><p data-edit-id="slide-03-text-5" class="">Es pirmo reizi ieraugu kaitu pludmalē</p></div></div><p class="source" data-edit-id="slide-03-text-6"><br></p></div><div class="photo" data-img="media/early-kite-local.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-03-img-0"><strong>AGRĪNS KAITS</strong><span>Vēsturiska kaita fotogrāfija no arhīva</span></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-04"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-04-text-0">03 / MANS SĀKUMS</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-04-text-1">Viss sākās…<br></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half photo" data-img="media/coast.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-04-img-0"><strong>MANS FOTOARHĪVS</strong><span>media/coast.webp</span></div><div class="half"><p class="callout" data-edit-id="slide-04-text-2">Puiši pludmalē piepūta kaut ko nesaprotamu. Un pēc mirkļa aizbrauca jūrā.</p><p class="sub" data-edit-id="slide-04-text-3">24.06.2015</p><p class="sub acid" data-edit-id="slide-04-text-4"><br></p></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-05"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-05-text-0">04 / MĀCĪBU METODE: NEDARI TĀ</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-05-text-1">Samuraja <span class="accent">ceļš.</span></h2><div class="cards"><div class="card"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-05-text-2">01 / SS.lv</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-05-text-3">Nopirku savu pirmo komplektu. Vēlāk izrādījās — tas paredzēts stiprākam vējam.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-05-text-4">02 / DVD</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-05-text-5">Pašmācība ar videomateriāliem. Bez instruktora un bez skaidras izpratnes.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-05-text-6">03 / Šūšana</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-05-text-7" class="">Vecais kaits plīsa, es kritu, ēdu smiltis un atkal braucu remontēt.</p></div></div><div class="retro-strip"><div class="retro-item" style="--dvd-photo: url(&quot;data:image/webp;base64,&quot;);"><div class="kicker">DVD · 2000. GADI</div><strong>Robby Naish</strong><span>Tolaik DVD, forumi un pieredzes stāsti aizstāja mūsdienu video pamācības.</span></div><div class="retro-item"><div class="kicker">Guide</div><strong>Papīrs + forumi</strong><span>Daudz kas tika saprasts no rakstiem, forumiem un citu pieredzes.</span></div><div class="retro-item"><div class="kicker">Realitāte</div><strong>Daudz kļūdu</strong><span>Tas nebija romantiski — tas bija dārgi, haotiski un reizēm bīstami.</span></div></div><div class="bottom"><p class="quote" data-edit-id="slide-05-text-8">“Mana pirmā sezona bija ļoti garš drošības instrukcijas pārkāpums.”</p><p class="mini" data-edit-id="slide-05-text-9">Šodien drošs sākums = nodarbības pie kvalificēta instruktora.</p></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-06"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-06-text-0">05 / INTERAKTĪVI</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-06-text-1">Neredzamais <span class="accent">vēja logs.</span></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half interactive"><svg class="diagram" viewBox="0 0 600 370"><path d="M65 320 A235 235 0 0 1 535 320" fill="none" stroke="#d8ff73" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="7 8"></path><path d="M140 320 A160 160 0 0 1 460 320" fill="none" stroke="#315f6e" stroke-width="3"></path><path d="M210 320 A90 90 0 0 1 390 320" fill="none" stroke="#315f6e" stroke-width="2"></path><circle cx="300" cy="320" r="9" fill="white"></circle><path d="M300 320L300 85" stroke="#59eddc" stroke-width="2" id="kiteLine"></path><path id="kiteMarker" d="M280 78 Q300 55 320 78 Q300 70 280 78Z" fill="#59eddc" transform="translate(0 0)"></path><text x="284" y="46">12</text><text x="47" y="339">9</text><text x="535" y="339">3</text><text x="260" y="358">BRAUCĒJS</text><text x="251" y="260" opacity=".6">JAUDAS ZONA</text></svg></div><div class="half"><p class="callout" id="windowLabel">12:00 — kaits virs galvas</p><p class="sub" id="windowDesc" data-edit-id="slide-06-text-3">Relatīvi mazāka vilkme, taču brāzmas var pacelt braucēju.</p><div class="options"><button class="opt selected" data-window="top">12:00</button><button class="opt" data-window="edge">Loga mala</button><button class="opt" data-window="power">Jaudas zona</button></div><p class="mini" data-edit-id="slide-06-text-4">Vienkāršota shēma demonstrācijai — nevis apmācība kaita vadīšanai.</p></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-07"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-07-text-0">06 / INTERAKTĪVI</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-07-text-1">Kur pūš <span class="accent">vējš?</span></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half interactive"><svg class="diagram" viewBox="0 0 520 340"><rect width="520" height="340" fill="#123849" rx="12"></rect><rect x="0" y="0" width="520" height="103" fill="#b1a283" opacity=".7"></rect><path d="M0 102 Q100 93 180 105 T350 104 T520 103" stroke="#e2d2a9" stroke-width="5" fill="none"></path><text x="22" y="45" font-size="19">KRASTS</text><text x="22" y="300" font-size="19">ŪDENS</text><path id="windArrow" d="M260 260L260 140" stroke="#59eddc" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(0 260 200)"></path><path id="windTip" d="M237 159L260 126L283 159" fill="none" stroke="#59eddc" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" transform="rotate(0 260 200)"></path></svg></div><div class="half"><p class="callout" id="windLabel">ONSHORE — uz krastu</p><p class="sub" id="windDesc" data-edit-id="slide-07-text-3">Vējš pūš uz krastu. Tomēr jāņem vērā viļņi, šķēršļi un situācija pie krasta.</p><div class="options"><button class="opt selected" data-wind="on">Onshore</button><button class="opt" data-wind="sideon">Side-onshore</button><button class="opt" data-wind="side">Side-shore</button><button class="opt" data-wind="off">Offshore</button></div></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-08"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-08-text-0">07 / INTERAKTĪVS INVENTĀRS</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-08-text-1">No kā tas <span class="accent">sastāv?</span></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half"><div class="options" id="gearBtns"><button class="opt selected" data-gear="kite"><span class="btn-thumb" style="" data-thumb-src="media/gear-kite.webp" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-0"></span><span>Kaits</span></button><button class="opt" data-gear="bar"><span class="btn-thumb" style="" data-thumb-src="media/gear-bar.webp" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-1"></span><span>Vadības stienis</span></button><button class="opt" data-gear="lines"><span class="btn-thumb" style="" data-thumb-src="media/gear-lines.webp" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-2"></span><span>Stropes</span></button><button class="opt" data-gear="harness"><span class="btn-thumb" style="" data-thumb-src="media/gear-harness.webp" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-3"></span><span>Trapece</span></button><button class="opt" data-gear="board"><span class="btn-thumb" style="" data-thumb-src="media/gear-board.webp" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-4"></span><span>Dēlis</span></button><button class="opt" data-gear="pump"><span class="btn-thumb" style="" data-thumb-src="media/gear-pump.webp" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-5"></span><span>Pumpis</span></button></div><p class="callout" id="gearLabel">KAITS</p><p class="sub" id="gearDesc" data-edit-id="slide-08-text-3">Piepūšams spārns, kas pārvērš vēju vilkmē un ir galvenais dzinējspēks.</p><p class="mini" data-edit-id="slide-08-text-4">Izvēlies inventāru — attēls atvērsies lielā skatā. Vēlreiz vari aplūkot arī galveno foto.</p></div><div class="half photo" id="gearPhoto" data-img="media/gear-kite.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-08-img-6"><strong>KAITS / FOTO</strong><span>media/gear-kite.webp</span></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-18"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-18-text-0">08 / DROŠĪBA</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-18-text-1">Drošības Sistēma</h2><div class="safety-flow"><div class="card"><div class="safety-visual" style="" data-photo-bg="media/safe-bar.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" data-slot-id="slide-18-img-0"></div><div class="tag" data-edit-id="slide-18-text-2">01 / PĀRVALDI</div><h3 data-edit-id="slide-18-text-3">Vadības stienis</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-18-text-4">Samazini vilkmi un saglabā kontroli, kad iespējams.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="safety-visual" style="" data-photo-bg="media/safe-qr.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" data-slot-id="slide-18-img-1"></div><div class="tag" data-edit-id="slide-18-text-5">02 / ATBRĪVO</div><h3 data-edit-id="slide-18-text-6">Quick release</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-18-text-7">Ātrās atbrīvošanas mehānisms samazina kaita vilkmi, aktivizējot drošības sistēmu.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="safety-visual" style="" data-photo-bg="media/safe-disconnect.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" data-slot-id="slide-18-img-2"></div><div class="tag" data-edit-id="slide-18-text-8">03 / PĒDĒJAIS SOLIS</div><h3 data-edit-id="slide-18-text-9">Pilnīga atvienošanās</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-18-text-10">Ārkārtas situācijā iespējama atvienošanās no kaita — atbilstoši konkrētajai sistēmai.</p></div></div><div class="bottom"><p class="callout acid" data-edit-id="slide-18-text-11">Iesācējiem — instruktors, droša vieta, pareizs inventārs.</p></div></section>

<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-09"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-0">08 / INTERAKTĪVI</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-1">Jo stiprāks vējš,<br><span class="accent">jo mazāks kaits.</span></h2><div class="grid2"><div class="interactive"><div class="tag" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-2">VĒJA STIPRUMS · ILUSTRĀCIJA</div><p class="number" id="windSpeed">18 <span>m/s</span></p><input id="speedSlider" type="range" min="6" max="18" value="9"><p class="small" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-4">Pārvieto slīdni — redzi, kā mainās aptuvens inventāra diapazons.</p></div><div class="interactive"><div class="tag" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-5">IESPĒJAMA KAITA KLASE</div><div class="number accent" id="kiteSize">5–7 m²</div><p class="sub" id="kiteSizeText" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-7">Ļoti stipra vēja ilustratīvs diapazons</p><p class="mini" data-edit-id="slide-09-text-8">Nav drošu izmēru tabula. Katram braucējam vajag savu vējam atbilstošu inventāru; bieži 3–4 kaiti.</p></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-10"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-10-text-0">09 / BALTIJAS REALITĀTE</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-10-text-1">Tas nav tikai<br><span class="accent">peldšortos.</span></h2><div class="kit-grid"><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-wetsuit.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-0"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-2">Hidrotērps</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-3">Pamata slānis Baltijas ūdenim.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-gloves.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-1"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-4">Cimdi</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-5">Aizsardzība aukstumā un saķerei.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-helmet.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-2"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-6">Ķivere</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-7">Drošība virs stila — vienmēr.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-boots.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-3"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-8">Zābaciņi</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-9">Siltumam un aizsardzībai.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/gear-harness.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-4"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-10">Trapece</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-11">Vilkmē atbrīvo rokas no slodzes.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-vest.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-5"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-12">Triecienveste</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-13">Papildu aizsardzība kritienos.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-hood.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-6"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-14">Kapuce / cepure</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-15">Siltumam, ja ūdens ir auksts.</p></div></div><div class="kit-card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā"><div class="img" style="" data-photo-bg="media/wear-fit.webp" data-slot-id="slide-10-img-7"></div><div class="txt"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-10-text-16">Cits </h3><p data-edit-id="slide-10-text-17">Galvenais komforts</p></div></div></div><p class="mini bottom" data-edit-id="slide-10-text-18">Katru ekipējuma attēlu vari atvērt pilnā izmērā.</p></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-11"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-11-text-0">10 / DISCIPLĪNAS</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-11-text-1">Viens kaits.<br><span class="accent">Četras pasaules.</span></h2><div class="cards" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)"><div class="card discipline-card" data-photo-bg="media/disc-freeride.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" style="" data-slot-id="slide-11-img-0"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-11-text-2">Kite Surfing</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-11-text-3">Ātrums, viļņi, brīvība.</p><div style="font-size:54px;margin-top:15px">≈</div></div><div class="card discipline-card" data-photo-bg="media/disc-bigair.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" style="" data-slot-id="slide-11-img-1"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-11-text-4">Big Air</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-11-text-5">Augstums un kontrolēti triki.</p><div style="font-size:54px;margin-top:15px">↗</div></div><div class="card discipline-card" data-photo-bg="media/disc-freestyle.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" style="" data-slot-id="slide-11-img-2"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-11-text-6">Freestyle</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-11-text-7">Tehniski un jaudīgi triki.</p><div style="font-size:54px;margin-top:15px">⟳</div></div><div class="card discipline-card" data-photo-bg="media/disc-hydrofoil.webp" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā" style="" data-slot-id="slide-11-img-3"><h3 data-edit-id="slide-11-text-8">Hydrofoil</h3><p data-edit-id="slide-11-text-9">Dēlis paceļas virs ūdens.</p><div style="font-size:54px;margin-top:15px">⌁</div></div></div></section>
<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-12"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-12-text-0">11 / MANA DISCIPLĪNA</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-12-text-1">Freeride.<br><span class="accent">Big Air.</span></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half photo" data-img="media/jump-air.webp" style="" data-slot-id="slide-12-img-0"><strong>MANS BIG AIR</strong><span>media/jump-air.webp</span></div><div class="half"><p class="quote" data-edit-id="slide-12-text-2">Ne tikai braukt.<br><span class="acid">Lidot.</span></p><p class="sub" data-edit-id="slide-12-text-3"><br></p></div></div></section>

<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-13">
  <div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-13-text-0">11A / MANS KAITSĒRFINGS KADROS</div>

 g.innerHTML=`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="6"/><text x="${x+dx}" y="${y+dy}" fill="#f2f7f7" font-weight="700">${name}</text>`;g.onclick=()=>setSpot(name);layer.appendChild(g)});function setSpot(name){let spot=spots.find(s=>s[0]===name);document.getElementById('spotTitle').textContent=spot[0];document.getElementById('spotDesc').textContent=spot[3];document.querySelectorAll('.spot').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('active',s.dataset.name===name));activate('[data-spot]','spot',name)}document.querySelectorAll('[data-spot]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setSpot(b.dataset.spot));setSpot('Liepāja');

function loadPhoto(el){
 const path=el.dataset.img;if(!path)return;

 el.style.backgroundImage='';el.classList.remove('loaded');
 if(fallback)put(fallback);
 let image=new Image();image.onload=()=>put(preferred);image.onerror=()=>{if(fallback)put(fallback)};image.src=preferred;
 if(preferred===fallback && fallback)put(fallback);
}

function loadBackdrops(){
 function visual(el, prop, path){
   if(!path)return;
   const local=window.KITE_ASSETS?.[path], preferred=window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES?.[path]||local||path;
   if(local)el.style.setProperty(prop,`url("${local}")`);
   if(preferred!==local){let img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if((el.dataset.photoBg||el.dataset.backdrop||el.dataset.thumbSrc)===path)el.style.setProperty(prop,`url("${preferred}")`)};img.onerror=()=>{};img.src=preferred;}
   else if(!local)el.style.setProperty(prop,`url("${preferred}")`);
 }
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-backdrop]').forEach(el=>visual(el,'--backdrop',el.dataset.backdrop));
 document.querySelectorAll('.discipline-card[data-photo-bg]').forEach(el=>visual(el,'--discipline',el.dataset.photoBg));
 document.querySelectorAll('.kit-card .img,.safety-visual').forEach(el=>{
   if(!el.dataset.photoBg){let m=(el.style.getPropertyValue('--img')||'').match(/url\(['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\)/);if(m)el.dataset.photoBg=m[1]}
   visual(el,'--img',el.dataset.photoBg);
 });
 document.querySelectorAll('.btn-thumb').forEach(el=>{
   if(!el.dataset.thumbSrc){let m=(el.style.backgroundImage||'').match(/url\(['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\)/);if(m)el.dataset.thumbSrc=m[1]}
   const path=el.dataset.thumbSrc;const local=window.KITE_ASSETS?.[path],preferred=window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES?.[path]||local||path;
   if(local)el.style.backgroundImage=`url("${local}")`;
   if(preferred!==local){let img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if(el.dataset.thumbSrc===path)el.style.backgroundImage=`url("${preferred}")`};img.src=preferred}
 });
 const dvd=document.querySelector('section[data-slide-id="slide-05"] .retro-item:first-child');if(dvd)dvd.style.setProperty('--dvd-photo',`url("${window.KITE_ASSETS['media/wave-action.webp']}")`);
}
window.kiteDeck={go,render,loadPhoto,loadBackdrops,dynamic:{gear,spots,seasons,winds,win},getActive:()=>slides[current],getVisibleSlides:()=>slides};
document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(loadPhoto);loadBackdrops();render();

(function(){

    let num=document.createElement('span');num.className='editor-slidenum';num.textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0');row.append(num);
    let jump=document.createElement('button');jump.className='jump';jump.textContent=slideLabel(s);jump.title=slideLabel(s);jump.onclick=()=>{if(s.dataset.hide==='1'){s.dataset.hide='0';scheduleSave()}let vis=slides().filter(n=>n.dataset.hide!=='1');deck.go(vis.indexOf(s));onSlideChange()};row.append(jump);
    for(const [label,dir,title] of [['↑',-1,'Вверх'],['↓',1,'Вниз']]){let b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=label;b.title=title;b.disabled=i+dir<0||i+dir>=slides().length;b.onclick=()=>{let other=slides()[i+dir];if(dir===-1)other.before(s);else other.after(s);onSlideChange();scheduleSave()};row.append(b)}
    let toggle=document.createElement('button');toggle.textContent=s.dataset.hide==='1'?'○':'◉';toggle.title=s.dataset.hide==='1'?'Показать слайд':'Скрыть слайд';toggle.onclick=()=>{if(s.dataset.hide!=='1'&&slides().filter(x=>x.dataset.hide!=='1').length<=1){setStatus('Нужно оставить хотя бы один слайд.');return}s.dataset.hide=s.dataset.hide==='1'?'0':'1';deck.render();onSlideChange();scheduleSave()};row.append(toggle);

function onSlideChange(){selected?.classList.remove('selected-element');selected=null;$('#hideElement').disabled=true;noteInput.value=active()?.dataset.note||'';buildSlideList()}

}
function showPhoto(index){
 if(index<0)index=albumKeys.length-1;if(index>=albumKeys.length)index=0;albumIndex=index;
 const path=albumKeys[index], label=labels[path.split('/').pop().split('.')[0]]||'Mans fotoarhīvs';
 $('#lightboxImage').src=albumSource(path);
 $('#lightboxTitle').textContent=label;
 $('#lightboxCounter').textContent=(index+1)+' / '+albumKeys.length;
 [...$('#lightboxThumbs').children].forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle('current',i===index));
 $('#lightboxThumbs').children[index]?.scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest',block:'nearest'});
 photoReplacePath=path;
}
function openAlbum(path){if(path&&!albumKeys.includes(path))albumKeys.push(path);if(!albumKeys.length)return;fillThumbs();let i=albumKeys.indexOf(path);showPhoto(i<0?0:i);lightbox.classList.add('open');$('#lightboxClose').focus();}
function closeAlbum(){lightbox.classList.remove('open');$('#lightboxImage').removeAttribute('src')}
$('#openGallery').onclick=()=>openAlbum();
  for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('.kit-card,.safety-visual,.discipline-card')){
    el.setAttribute('tabindex','0');el.setAttribute('role','button');
    el.setAttribute('aria-label','Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā');
    el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();el.click()}});
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#gearBtns [data-gear]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',(event)=>{if(!event.isTrusted)return;const path=document.getElementById('gearPhoto')?.dataset.img;if(path)openAlbum(path)}));
$('#lightboxClose').onclick=closeAlbum;
$('#lightboxPrev').onclick=()=>showPhoto(albumIndex-1);
$('#lightboxNext').onclick=()=>showPhoto(albumIndex+1);
$('#lightboxReplace').onclick=()=>{if(!document.body.classList.contains('editing'))return;fileInput.click()};
lightbox.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===lightbox)closeAlbum()};
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const img=e.target.closest('.photo,.kit-card,.safety-visual,.discipline-card');
  if(img){e.preventDefault();const path=img.dataset.img||img.dataset.photoBg||img.querySelector('.img')?.dataset.photoBg;
    if(path)openAlbum(path);
    else if(document.body.classList.contains('editing')){photoReplacePath=path;fileInput.click();}
    return;
  }
  if(document.body.classList.contains('editing')){const el=isEditable(e.target);if(el){selected?.classList.remove('selected-element');selected=el;selected.classList.add('selected-element');$('#hideElement').disabled=false;$('#hideElement').textContent=el.dataset.hidden==='1'?'Показать текст':'Скрыть текст';}}
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(e.key==='Escape'){closeAlbum();if(document.body.classList.contains('editing')&&document.activeElement?.isContentEditable)document.activeElement.blur()}
 if(!lightbox.classList.contains('open'))return;
 if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();showPhoto(albumIndex+1)}
 if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();showPhoto(albumIndex-1)}
});
document.querySelectorAll('section.slide').forEach(s=>s.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-edit-id]')){buildSlideList();scheduleSave()}}));
async function resizeImage(file){
 return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(file),im=new Image();
  im.onload=()=>{try{let w=im.naturalWidth,h=im.naturalHeight,scale=Math.min(1,2200/Math.max(w,h));let cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(w*scale));cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(h*scale));cv.getContext('2d',{alpha:false}).drawImage(im,0,0,cv.width,cv.height);const data=cv.toDataURL('image/webp',.84);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);resolve(data)}catch(err){reject(err)}};
  im.onerror=()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);reject(new Error('Невозможно прочитать изображение'))};im.src=url;
 });
}
fileInput.onchange=async()=>{const file=fileInput.files?.[0];fileInput.value='';if(!file||!photoReplacePath)return;try{
 let data=await resizeImage(file);window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES[photoReplacePath]=data;document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(deck.loadPhoto);deck.loadBackdrops();updateQuickEditor();if(lightbox.classList.contains('open')){showPhoto(albumIndex);fillThumbs()}scheduleSave();setStatus('Фотография заменена. Сохраняется автоматически.');
 }catch(err){setStatus('Ошибка фото: '+err.message)}};
function snapshot(){
 let edits={};document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]').forEach(e=>edits[e.dataset.editId]={html:e.innerHTML,hidden:e.dataset.hidden==='1'});
 let notes={};slides().forEach(s=>notes[s.dataset.slideId]={note:s.dataset.note||'',hidden:s.dataset.hide==='1'});
 const imageSlots={};document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot-id]').forEach(el=>{
   imageSlots[el.dataset.slotId]={img:el.dataset.img||null,photoBg:el.dataset.photoBg||null,backdrop:el.dataset.backdrop||null,thumbSrc:el.dataset.thumbSrc||null};
 });
 const customSlides=slides().filter(s=>s.dataset.customSlide==='1').map(s=>s.outerHTML);
 return {version:5,edits,notes,order:slides().map(s=>s.dataset.slideId),photoOverrides:window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES,imageSlots,customSlides,dynamicOptions:copyDynamicState()};
}
function applyData(data){if(!data||!data.version)return;
 (data.customSlides||[]).forEach(markup=>{const tmp=document.createElement('template');tmp.innerHTML=markup;const node=tmp.content.querySelector('section.slide');if(node&&!document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="'+node.dataset.slideId+'"]')){document.querySelector('.meta').before(node);attachEditIds(node)}});
 let map=new Map(slides().map(s=>[s.dataset.slideId,s]));
 for(const id of data.order||[]){let slide=map.get(id);if(slide)document.querySelector('.meta').before(slide)}
  {const g=document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="slide-08"]'),a=document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="slide-18"]');if(g&&a)g.after(a)}
 for(const s of slides()){let x=data.notes?.[s.dataset.slideId];if(x){s.dataset.note=x.note||'';s.dataset.hide=x.hidden?'1':'0'}}
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]').forEach(el=>{let x=data.edits?.[el.dataset.editId];if(x){el.innerHTML=x.html;el.dataset.hidden=x.hidden?'1':'0'}});
 if(data.photoOverrides)window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES={...window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES,...data.photoOverrides};
 if(data.imageSlots)Object.entries(data.imageSlots).forEach(([id,v])=>{const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot-id]')].find(e=>e.dataset.slotId===id);if(!el)return;
   ['img','photoBg','backdrop','thumbSrc'].forEach(key=>{if(v[key])el.dataset[key]=v[key]});});
 if(data.dynamicOptions)applyDynamicState(data.dynamicOptions);
 albumKeys=[...new Set([...albumKeys,...Object.keys(window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES).filter(x=>x.startsWith('custom/'))])];
 deck.loadBackdrops();document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(deck.loadPhoto);deck.render();onSlideChange();
}
const KEY='kite-editor-'+(document.documentElement.dataset.deckKey||'2026-v2');
function db(){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!indexedDB){reject(new Error('IndexedDB unavailable'));return}let r=indexedDB.open('kitePresentationEditor',2);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains('drafts'))r.result.createObjectStore('drafts');if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains('media'))r.result.createObjectStore('media')};r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)})}
async function store(val){try{let d=await db();await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{let t=d.transaction('drafts','readwrite');t.objectStore('drafts').put(val,KEY);t.oncomplete=ok;t.onerror=()=>fail(t.error)});d.close();setStatus('Сохранено в этом браузере ✓')}catch(e){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(val));setStatus('Сохранено локально ✓')}catch(e2){setStatus('Память браузера заполнена — скачай редактируемый HTML.')}}}
async function getDraft(){try{let d=await db();let r=await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{let t=d.transaction('drafts','readonly'),q=t.objectStore('drafts').get(KEY);q.onsuccess=()=>ok(q.result);q.onerror=()=>fail(q.error)});d.close();return r||null}catch(e){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null')}catch(e2){return null}}}
function scheduleSave(){clearTimeout(saveTimer);saveTimer=setTimeout(()=>store(snapshot()),500)}
function saveFile(blob,name){let u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=name;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),2000)}
function exportHTML(makePublic){
 const root=document.documentElement.cloneNode(true),body=root.querySelector('body');body.classList.remove('editing');
 root.dataset.public=makePublic?'true':'false';root.dataset.deckKey='rev-'+Date.now();
 root.querySelector('#quickSaveToast')?.classList.remove('show');
 const toast=root.querySelector('#quickSaveToast');if(toast)toast.textContent='';
 const ov=root.querySelector('#photo-overrides');ov.textContent=JSON.stringify(window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES).replace(/</g,'\\u003c');
 root.querySelectorAll('[contenteditable]').forEach(el=>el.removeAttribute('contenteditable'));
 root.querySelectorAll('.selected-element').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('selected-element'));
 // Photo backgrounds are derived from KITE_ASSETS and should not be duplicated as giant inline CSS.
 root.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(el=>{el.style.removeProperty('background-image');el.classList.remove('loaded')});
 root.querySelector('#photoLightbox')?.classList.remove('open');
 root.querySelector('#photoLightbox img')?.removeAttribute('src');
 root.querySelectorAll('#lightboxThumbs > *').forEach(el=>el.remove());
 const video=root.querySelector('#estoniaVideo');if(video){video.removeAttribute('src');video.querySelector('source')?.setAttribute('src','media/haademeeste.mp4')}
 root.querySelector('#estoniaEmpty')?.removeAttribute('style');
 root.querySelectorAll('[style]').forEach(el=>{for(const key of ['--backdrop','--discipline','--img'])if(el.style?.getPropertyValue(key))el.style.removeProperty(key);if(el.matches('.btn-thumb'))el.style.removeProperty('background-image')});
 root.querySelector('#kite-dynamic').textContent=JSON.stringify(copyDynamicState()).replace(/</g,'\\u003c');
 // Assets are embedded. All text and ordering are already present in DOM snapshot.
 return '<!doctype html>\n'+root.outerHTML;
}
$('#saveNow').onclick=()=>store(snapshot());
$('#exportEditable').onclick=()=>{saveFile(new Blob([exportHTML(false)],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'}),'kaitsurfings-redigejams.html');setStatus('Редактируемый файл скачан.')};
$('#exportPublic').onclick=()=>{saveFile(new Blob([exportHTML(true)],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'}),'kaitsurfings-publisks.html');setStatus('Файл для коллег скачан.')};
$('#exportBackup').onclick=()=>saveFile(new Blob([JSON.stringify(snapshot(),null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),'kaitsurfings-rezerve.json');
$('#importBackup').onclick=()=>$('#backupFile').click();
$('#backupFile').onchange=async()=>{try{const file=$('#backupFile').files[0];if(!file)return;let data=JSON.parse(await file.text());applyData(data);scheduleSave();setStatus('Резервная копия восстановлена ✓')}catch(e){setStatus('Не получилось открыть копию: '+e.message)}$('#backupFile').value=''};
// Preserve picture-level image links in interactive descriptions, no external browser libraries.
(async()=>{applyDynamicState(JSON.parse($('#kite-dynamic').textContent||'{}'));if(document.documentElement.dataset.public!=='true'){let draft=await getDraft();if(draft)applyData(draft)}onSlideChange();})().catch(e=>setStatus(e.message));
// Update sidebar when slides navigate using normal controls in presentation mode.
['prev','next'].forEach(id=>$('#'+id).addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(onSlideChange,0)));


// ---- V5 ACCESSIBLE EDITOR: edit all slide copy, each visual slot independently. ----
function attachEditIds(slide){
 const targets=slide.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,p,.eyebrow,.pill,.tag,.spot-label,.number');
 targets.forEach((el,i)=>{
  if(el.id&&['windSpeed','kiteSize','gearLabel','windLabel','spotTitle','seasonTitle','windowLabel','gearDesc','spotDesc','windDesc','seasonDesc','windowDesc'].includes(el.id))return;
  if(el.closest('.options,.meta,.controls'))return;
  if(!el.dataset.editId)el.dataset.editId=slide.dataset.slideId+'-text-'+i;
  if(document.body.classList.contains('editing'))el.contentEditable='true';
 });
 slide.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-edit-id]')){buildSlideList();scheduleSave()}});
}
function assignImageSlots(){
 slides().forEach(s=>{
  s.querySelectorAll('.photo,.discipline-card[data-photo-bg],.kit-card .img,.safety-visual,.btn-thumb').forEach((el,i)=>{
   if(!el.dataset.slotId)el.dataset.slotId=s.dataset.slideId+'-img-'+i;
  });
  if(s.dataset.backdrop&&!s.dataset.slotId)s.dataset.slotId=s.dataset.slideId+'-backdrop';
 });
}
assignImageSlots();
const dynNames={gear:'Inventārs',spots:'Karte',seasons:'Gadalaiki',winds:'Vēja virzieni',win:'Vēja logs'};
function copyDynamicState(){
 const d=deck.dynamic;
 return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d).map(([key,values])=>[key,JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(values))]));
}
function applyDynamicState(state){
 if(!state||typeof state!=='object')return;
 const d=deck.dynamic;
 for(let [name,src] of Object.entries(state)){
  if(!d[name]||!src)continue;
  if(Array.isArray(d[name])&&Array.isArray(src)){
   d[name].forEach((entry,i)=>{if(src[i]&&entry[0]===src[i][0])src[i].forEach((v,j)=>entry[j]=v)});
  }else if(typeof d[name]==='object'){
   for(let k of Object.keys(d[name]))if(Array.isArray(src[k]))src[k].forEach((v,i)=>d[name][k][i]=v);
  }
 }
 // Only refresh currently chosen options; never change the current slide.
 ['gear','wind','window','season'].forEach(k=>document.querySelector('.opt.selected[data-'+k+']')?.click());
 const spot=document.querySelector('.opt.selected[data-spot]');if(spot)spot.click();
}
let activeImageSlot=null;
function labelImage(el){
 if(el.dataset.backdrop)return 'Фон слайда';
 if(el.id==='gearPhoto')return 'Большая иллюстрация выбранного оборудования';
 if(el.id==='seasonPhoto')return 'Сезонная фотография';
 let heading=el.closest('.card,.kit-card')?.querySelector('h3')?.textContent||el.querySelector('strong')?.textContent||el.closest('[data-gear]')?.textContent||'';
 if(el.classList.contains('btn-thumb'))return 'Миниатюра: '+el.closest('button')?.textContent.trim();
 return heading.trim().slice(0,70)||'Картинка';
}
function currentImageSlots(){
 const s=active();if(!s)return[];
 const els=[...s.querySelectorAll('.photo,.discipline-card[data-photo-bg],.kit-card .img,.safety-visual,.btn-thumb')];
 if(s.dataset.backdrop)els.unshift(s);
 return els.filter(el=>el.dataset.img||el.dataset.photoBg||el.dataset.backdrop||el.dataset.thumbSrc);
}
function assetPath(el){return el.dataset.img||el.dataset.photoBg||el.dataset.backdrop||el.dataset.thumbSrc||''}
function updateQuickEditor(){
 if(!document.body.classList.contains('editing'))return;
 const t=$('#quickTextFields'),i=$('#quickImageFields'),d=$('#dynamicTextFields'),s=active();if(!t||!i||!d||!s)return;
 assignImageSlots();
 t.replaceChildren();i.replaceChildren();d.replaceChildren();
 const textEls=[...s.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]')].filter(el=>!el.closest('.options'));
 let count=0;
 for(const el of textEls){
  const walk=document.createTreeWalker(el,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),nodes=[];
  while(walk.nextNode())if(walk.currentNode.nodeValue.trim())nodes.push(walk.currentNode);
  for(const [nidx,node] of nodes.entries()){
   if(count>=44)break;
   const raw=node.nodeValue;
   const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='edit-field';
   const lab=document.createElement('label');lab.textContent=(el.classList.contains('eyebrow')?'Раздел':el.tagName.toUpperCase())+(nodes.length>1?' · часть '+(nidx+1):'');
   const field=document.createElement(raw.trim().length>90?'textarea':'input');
   if(field.tagName==='INPUT')field.type='text';else field.rows=2;
   field.value=raw.trim();field.oninput=()=>{
    const m=raw.match(/^\s*/)?.[0]||'',e=raw.match(/\s*$/)?.[0]||'';
    node.nodeValue=m+field.value+e;
    buildSlideList();scheduleSave();
   };
   wrap.append(lab,field);t.append(wrap);count++;
  }
 }
 if(!count)t.innerHTML='<p class="editor-help">Этот слайд редактируется прямо на экране.</p>';
 for(const el of currentImageSlots()){
  const path=assetPath(el),src=albumSource(path),row=document.createElement('div');row.className='edit-item';
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.alt='';img.src=src;
  const label=document.createElement('div');label.className='edit-item-label';label.textContent=labelImage(el);
  const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.textContent='Заменить';button.onclick=()=>{activeImageSlot=el;$('#quickImageInput').click()};
  const fit=document.createElement('button');fit.type='button';fit.textContent=(el.dataset.fit==='contain'?'Целиком':'Обрезка');fit.title='Переключить режим кадрирования';fit.onclick=()=>{el.dataset.fit=el.dataset.fit==='contain'?'cover':'contain';fit.textContent=el.dataset.fit==='contain'?'Целиком':'Обрезка';scheduleSave();setStatus('Режим кадрирования изменён ✓')};
   row.append(img,label,fit,button);i.append(row);
 }
 if(!i.childElementCount)i.innerHTML='<p class="editor-help">На этом слайде нет фотографий. Можешь добавить отдельный слайд с фото.</p>';
 $('#deleteCustomSlide').style.display=s.dataset.customSlide==='1'?'block':'none';
 const configs=[];
 if(s.querySelector('#gearBtns'))Object.keys(deck.dynamic.gear).forEach(k=>configs.push(['gear',k,1,2,deck.dynamic.gear[k][0]]));
 if(s.querySelector('#spotLayer'))deck.dynamic.spots.forEach((spot,index)=>configs.push(['spots',index,3,null,spot[0]]));
 if(s.querySelector('[data-season]'))Object.keys(deck.dynamic.seasons).forEach(k=>configs.push(['seasons',k,1,2,k==='water'?'Ūdens':'Sniegs']));
 if(s.querySelector('[data-wind]'))Object.keys(deck.dynamic.winds).forEach(k=>configs.push(['winds',k,0,1,k]));
 if(s.querySelector('[data-window]'))Object.keys(deck.dynamic.win).forEach(k=>configs.push(['win',k,0,1,k]));
 for(const [group,key,titleIdx,descIdx,caption] of configs){
  const arr=deck.dynamic[group][key],block=document.createElement('div');block.className='edit-field';
  const lab=document.createElement('label');lab.textContent=caption;
  const inp=document.createElement('textarea');inp.rows=2;inp.value=arr[descIdx===null?titleIdx:descIdx]||'';
  inp.oninput=()=>{arr[descIdx===null?titleIdx:descIdx]=inp.value;document.querySelector('.opt.selected[data-'+({gear:'gear',spots:'spot',seasons:'season',winds:'wind',win:'window'}[group])+']')?.click();scheduleSave()};
  block.append(lab,inp);d.append(block);
 }
 if(!d.childElementCount)d.innerHTML='<p class="editor-help">Здесь нет дополнительных интерактивных подписей.</p>';
}
$('#quickImageInput').onchange=async()=>{
 const input=$('#quickImageInput'),file=input.files?.[0];input.value='';const el=activeImageSlot;activeImageSlot=null;
 if(!file||!el)return;
 try{
  const data=await resizeImage(file),slot=el.dataset.slotId||'new';
  const key='custom/'+slot+'.webp';window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES[key]=data;
  if(el.id==='gearPhoto'){
    const k=document.querySelector('.opt.selected[data-gear]')?.dataset.gear||'kite';deck.dynamic.gear[k][2]=key;
    const thumb=document.querySelector('.opt.selected[data-gear] .btn-thumb');if(thumb)thumb.dataset.thumbSrc=key;
  }else if(el.id==='seasonPhoto'){
    const k=document.querySelector('.opt.selected[data-season]')?.dataset.season||'water';deck.dynamic.seasons[k][3]=key;
  }
  if(el.classList.contains('photo'))el.dataset.img=key;
  else if(el.dataset.backdrop)el.dataset.backdrop=key;
  else if(el.classList.contains('btn-thumb'))el.dataset.thumbSrc=key;
  else el.dataset.photoBg=key;
  if(!albumKeys.includes(key))albumKeys.push(key);
  document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(deck.loadPhoto);deck.loadBackdrops();
  updateQuickEditor();scheduleSave();setStatus('Изображение заменено ✓');
 }catch(err){setStatus('Не получилось добавить фото: '+err.message)};
};
$('#addTextLine').onclick=()=>{
 const s=active();if(!s)return;
 const el=document.createElement('p');el.className='sub';el.textContent='Jauns teksts — maini šo frāzi.';
 const base=s.querySelector('.bottom');if(base)base.before(el);else s.append(el);
 attachEditIds(s);el.contentEditable='true';el.focus();updateQuickEditor();scheduleSave();
};
$('#addNewSlide').onclick=()=>{
 const id='my-slide-'+Date.now();
 const el=document.createElement('section');el.className='slide';el.dataset.slideId=id;el.dataset.customSlide='1';el.dataset.note='Jauns slaids. Šeit pievieno savas piezīmes.';
 el.innerHTML='<div class="eyebrow">MANS SLAIDS</div><h2 class="heading">Jauns <span class="accent">slaids.</span></h2><div class="flex"><div class="half"><p class="quote">Uzraksti savu galveno domu.</p><p class="sub">Šeit vari pievienot stāstu vai paskaidrojumu.</p></div><div class="half photo"><strong>IEVIETO FOTO</strong><span>Atver redaktoru un izvēlies attēlu</span></div></div>';
 const photo=el.querySelector('.photo');photo.dataset.img='custom/'+id+'-placeholder.webp';
 active().after(el);attachEditIds(el);assignImageSlots();deck.render();
 const visible=deck.getVisibleSlides();deck.go(visible.indexOf(el));onSlideChange();scheduleSave();
};
$('#deleteCustomSlide').onclick=()=>{
 const s=active();if(s?.dataset.customSlide!=='1')return;
 s.remove();deck.go(Math.max(0,deck.getVisibleSlides().indexOf(s)-1));deck.render();onSlideChange();scheduleSave();
};
// update side panel after any interaction and change of slide without modifying presentation scripts
const oldOnSlideChange=onSlideChange;
onSlideChange=function(){oldOnSlideChange();updateQuickEditor()};
$('#closeEditor').addEventListener('click',()=>{document.activeElement?.blur?.()});
$('#editorToggle').addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(updateQuickEditor,0));
$('#prev').addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(updateQuickEditor,0));
$('#next').addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(updateQuickEditor,0));
// Clicking an interactive button refreshes editable descriptions, while the presentation remains interactive.
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-gear],[data-spot],[data-season],[data-wind],[data-window]'))setTimeout(updateQuickEditor,0)});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(document.body.classList.contains('editing')&&(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='s'){
  e.preventDefault();$('#exportEditable').click();
 }
});

// HÄÄDEMEESTE VIDEO: local MP4 upload, in-browser preview, and export as website ZIP.
let estoniaFile=null, estoniaUrl=null;
const videoEl=$('#estoniaVideo'), videoStatus=$('#editorVideoStatus'), videoSlide=document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="slide-estonia-video"]');
const chooseVideo=$('#chooseEstoniaVideo'),videoInput=$('#editorVideoFile');
chooseVideo.onclick=()=>videoInput.click();
async function mediaDb(){let d=await db();return d}
function setEstoniaVideo(file){
  if(estoniaUrl)URL.revokeObjectURL(estoniaUrl);
  estoniaFile=file||null;
  if(file){
    estoniaUrl=URL.createObjectURL(file);videoEl.pause();videoEl.src=estoniaUrl;videoEl.load();
    videoSlide.dataset.hide='0';$('#estoniaEmpty').style.display='none';
    videoStatus.textContent='✓ '+file.name+' ('+(file.size/1048576).toFixed(1)+' MB). Видео появится в ZIP рядом с HTML.';
  }else{estoniaUrl=null;videoEl.pause();videoEl.removeAttribute('src');videoEl.querySelector('source')?.setAttribute('src','media/haademeeste.mp4');videoEl.load();
    videoSlide.dataset.hide='1';$('#estoniaEmpty').style.display='flex';
    videoStatus.textContent='Видео удалено. Слайд скрыт до новой загрузки.';
  }
  deck.render();onSlideChange();scheduleSave();
}
async function persistVideo(file){
 let d=await mediaDb();await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{let t=d.transaction('media','readwrite');t.objectStore('media').put(file,'haademeeste');t.oncomplete=resolve;t.onerror=()=>reject(t.error)});d.close();
}
async function loadPersistedVideo(){
 try{let d=await mediaDb();let file=await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{let t=d.transaction('media','readonly');let q=t.objectStore('media').get('haademeeste');q.onsuccess=()=>ok(q.result);q.onerror=()=>fail(q.error)});d.close();if(file)setEstoniaVideo(file)}catch(err){videoStatus.textContent='Локальная память видео недоступна — можно выбрать файл повторно.'}
}
videoInput.onchange=async()=>{let file=videoInput.files?.[0];videoInput.value='';if(!file)return;
 try{if(file.size>250*1024*1024){videoStatus.textContent='Файл больше 250 MB. Для публикации лучше сжать его до MP4 H.264.';return}
 await persistVideo(file);setEstoniaVideo(file);if(/\.mov$/i.test(file.name))videoStatus.textContent+=' Внимание: MOV может не работать в браузере; рекомендован MP4 (H.264).';
 }catch(err){setEstoniaVideo(file);videoStatus.textContent+=' Сохранение в браузере не удалось — экспортируй ZIP до закрытия вкладки.'}
};
$('#removeEstoniaVideo').onclick=async()=>{try{let d=await mediaDb();await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{let t=d.transaction('media','readwrite');t.objectStore('media').delete('haademeeste');t.oncomplete=ok;t.onerror=()=>fail(t.error)});d.close()}catch(e){}setEstoniaVideo(null)};
videoEl.addEventListener('error',()=>{if(estoniaFile)videoStatus.textContent='Видео не воспроизводится. Конвертируй MOV/HEVC в MP4 H.264 + AAC.'});
// A small, dependency-free ZIP writer (store method). MP4 is already compressed.
const enc=new TextEncoder();
const crcTable=new Uint32Array(256);for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xedb88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;crcTable[n]=c>>>0}
function crc(bytes){let v=0xffffffff;for(let k=0;k<bytes.length;k++)v=crcTable[(v^bytes[k])&255]^(v>>>8);return(v^0xffffffff)>>>0}
function zipStore(files){let offset=0,parts=[],central=[];
 for(let f of files){const name=enc.encode(f.name);const bytes=f.data instanceof Uint8Array?f.data:enc.encode(f.data);let val=crc(bytes);
  let h=new Uint8Array(30+name.length),dv=new DataView(h.buffer);dv.setUint32(0,0x04034b50,true);dv.setUint16(4,20,true);dv.setUint16(6,0x0800,true);dv.setUint16(8,0,true);
  dv.setUint32(14,val,true);dv.setUint32(18,bytes.length,true);dv.setUint32(22,bytes.length,true);dv.setUint16(26,name.length,true);h.set(name,30);parts.push(h,bytes);
  let c=new Uint8Array(46+name.length),dc=new DataView(c.buffer);dc.setUint32(0,0x02014b50,true);dc.setUint16(4,20,true);dc.setUint16(6,20,true);dc.setUint16(8,0x0800,true);dc.setUint16(10,0,true);dc.setUint32(16,val,true);dc.setUint32(20,bytes.length,true);dc.setUint32(24,bytes.length,true);dc.setUint16(28,name.length,true);dc.setUint32(42,offset,true);c.set(name,46);central.push(c);offset+=h.length+bytes.length;
 }
 const size=central.reduce((n,v)=>n+v.length,0),end=new Uint8Array(22),de=new DataView(end.buffer);de.setUint32(0,0x06054b50,true);de.setUint16(8,files.length,true);de.setUint16(10,files.length,true);de.setUint32(12,size,true);de.setUint32(16,offset,true);
 return new Blob([...parts,...central,end],{type:'application/zip'});
}
$('#exportSiteZip').onclick=async()=>{
 try{setStatus('Упаковываю сайт и видео…');let pack=[{name:'index.html',data:exportHTML(true)},
 {name:'README.txt',data:'Kaitsērfings — tīmekļa prezentācija. Atveriet index.html pārlūkā. Ja pievienots video, tā fails atrodas media/haademeeste.mp4. Lai publicētu: augšupielādējiet visu ZIP saturu kā vienu vietni (Cloudflare Pages / Netlify).'}];
 if(estoniaFile){pack.push({name:'media/haademeeste.mp4',data:new Uint8Array(await estoniaFile.arrayBuffer())})}
 saveFile(zipStore(pack),'kaitsurfings-vietne-ar-video.zip');setStatus('Сайт ZIP скачан. '+(estoniaFile?'Видео включено ✓':'Видео ещё не добавлено.'));
 }catch(err){setStatus('Ошибка ZIP: '+err.message)}
};

// Preserve photos and edits from a user's exported v6.1 HTML without restoring old slide order.
const previousHtmlButton=document.getElementById('importPreviousHtml');
const previousHtmlInput=document.getElementById('previousHtmlFile');
if(previousHtmlButton&&previousHtmlInput){
  previousHtmlButton.onclick=()=>previousHtmlInput.click();
  previousHtmlInput.onchange=async()=>{
    const f=previousHtmlInput.files?.[0];previousHtmlInput.value='';if(!f)return;
    try{
      const txt=await f.text();const oldDoc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(txt,'text/html');
      if(!oldDoc.querySelector('section.slide'))throw Error('Это не файл презентации');
      let importedTexts=0,importedPhotos=0;
      let oldAssets={};
      try{oldAssets=JSON.parse(oldDoc.querySelector('#kite-assets')?.textContent||'{}')}catch(e){}
      // Preserve new assets, but allow carried-over personal/custom images.
      for(const [path,uri] of Object.entries(oldAssets)){
        if((path.startsWith('custom/')||!(path in window.KITE_ASSETS))&&typeof uri==='string')window.KITE_ASSETS[path]=uri;
      }
      const embed=document.getElementById('kite-assets');
      if(embed)embed.textContent=JSON.stringify(window.KITE_ASSETS).replace(/</g,'\\u003c');
      let ov={};try{ov=JSON.parse(oldDoc.querySelector('#photo-overrides')?.textContent||'{}')}catch(e){}
      window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES={...window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES,...ov};
      const oldSlides=new Map([...oldDoc.querySelectorAll('section.slide')].map(x=>[x.dataset.slideId,x]));
      for(const currentSlide of slides()){
        const previous=oldSlides.get(currentSlide.dataset.slideId);if(!previous)continue;
        if(previous.dataset.note)currentSlide.dataset.note=previous.dataset.note;
        // Keep new slide visibility for default content; restore explicit hides only.
        if(previous.dataset.hide==='1'&&currentSlide.dataset.slideId!=='slide-18')currentSlide.dataset.hide='1';
        const prevTexts=new Map([...previous.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]')].map(x=>[x.dataset.editId,x]));
        for(const el of currentSlide.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]')){
          const p=prevTexts.get(el.dataset.editId);if(!p)continue;
          el.innerHTML=p.innerHTML;el.dataset.hidden=p.dataset.hidden||'0';importedTexts++;
        }
        const prevSlots=new Map([...previous.querySelectorAll('[data-slot-id]')].map(x=>[x.dataset.slotId,x]));
        for(const el of currentSlide.querySelectorAll('[data-slot-id]')){
          const p=prevSlots.get(el.dataset.slotId);if(!p)continue;
          for(const attr of ['img','photoBg','thumbSrc','backdrop']){
            if(p.dataset[attr]&&el.dataset[attr]!==p.dataset[attr]){el.dataset[attr]=p.dataset[attr];importedPhotos++}
          }
        }
      }
      // Keep any unchanged source paths with personal overrides from the previous version.
      importedPhotos+=Object.keys(ov).length;
      const newPhotoJson=document.getElementById('photo-overrides');
      if(newPhotoJson)newPhotoJson.textContent=JSON.stringify(window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES).replace(/</g,'\\u003c');
      const gearSlide=document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="slide-08"]');const safeSlide=document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="slide-18"]');
      if(gearSlide&&safeSlide)gearSlide.after(safeSlide);
      // Remove old photo background even if an older edit left it in the fifth slide.
      const fifth=document.querySelector('[data-slide-id="slide-05"]');
      if(fifth)fifth.querySelectorAll('.retro-item').forEach(x=>x.style.removeProperty('--dvd-photo'));
      deck.loadBackdrops();document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(deck.loadPhoto);
      deck.render();onSlideChange();updateQuickEditor();scheduleSave();
      setStatus('Импорт готов: '+importedTexts+' текстовых блоков, '+importedPhotos+' фото-настроек. Скачай обновлённый HTML после редактирования.');
    }catch(err){setStatus('Не получилось импортировать HTML: '+err.message)}
  };
}

window.kiteSaveBridge={exportHTML,snapshot,store,saveFile};
if(document.documentElement.dataset.public!=='true')loadPersistedVideo();
})();

 !e.target.closest('input,textarea,[contenteditable="true"]')&&

<script id="kite-editor-autorun">
(function(){
 function launch(){
   if(document.documentElement.dataset.public==='true')return;
   const trigger=document.getElementById('editorToggle');
   if(trigger&&!document.body.classList.contains('editing'))trigger.click();
   if(!document.body.classList.contains('editing')){
     document.body.classList.add('editing');
     document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]').forEach(el=>el.setAttribute('contenteditable','true'));
   }
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',launch,{once:true});
 else launch();
 window.addEventListener('load',function(){if(!document.body.classList.contains('editing'))launch()},{once:true});
})();
</script>
<script id="kite-save-one-click-v64">
(function(){
 'use strict';
 if(document.documentElement.dataset.public==='true')return;
 const bridge=window.kiteSaveBridge;
 if(!bridge){console.error('Kite editor save bridge unavailable');return;}
 const {exportHTML,snapshot,store,saveFile}=bridge;
 const buttons=['quickSaveFile','quickSavePanel'].map(id=>document.getElementById(id));
 const toast=document.getElementById('quickSaveToast');
 let saveHandle=null, busy=false, toastTimer=null;
 const DB_NAME='kiteHTMLSavedFiles';
 const DB_STORE='files';
 const DB_KEY='kitesurfing-current-editor';
 function openHandleDB(){return new Promise((ok,fail)=>{
   if(!window.indexedDB){fail(new Error('IndexedDB unsupported'));return}
   const r=indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,1);
   r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains(DB_STORE))r.result.createObjectStore(DB_STORE)};
   r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result);r.onerror=()=>fail(r.error);
 });}
 async function rememberHandle(handle){
   try{const d=await openHandleDB();await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{
      const t=d.transaction(DB_STORE,'readwrite');t.objectStore(DB_STORE).put(handle,DB_KEY);
      t.oncomplete=ok;t.onerror=()=>fail(t.error);
   });d.close();}catch(e){} 
 }
 async function restoreHandle(){
   try{const d=await openHandleDB();const h=await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{
       const q=d.transaction(DB_STORE,'readonly').objectStore(DB_STORE).get(DB_KEY);
       q.onsuccess=()=>ok(q.result);q.onerror=()=>fail(q.error);
   });d.close();if(h && h.kind==='file'){saveHandle=h;updateButtonLabel();}}
   catch(e){}
 }
 function showMessage(message,warning=false){
   toast.textContent=message;toast.style.borderColor=warning?'#ffb6a466':'#d8ff7366';
   toast.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);
   toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),4600);
   const st=document.getElementById('editorStatus');if(st)st.textContent=message;
 }
 function updateButtonLabel(){
   for(const b of buttons){if(!b)continue;
     b.textContent=saveHandle?'💾 Сохранить':'💾 Сохранить';
     b.title=saveHandle?('Сохранить изменения в файл '+saveHandle.name):'Сохранить редактируемый HTML на компьютер';
   }
 }
 // Called synchronously by an explicit click. The picker is opened BEFORE any
 // awaited operation so the browser does not lose transient user activation.
 async function savePresentation(){
   if(busy)return;
   busy=true;for(const b of buttons){if(b)b.disabled=true}
   let mode='download';
   try{
     let handle=saveHandle;
     if(!handle && typeof window.showSaveFilePicker==='function'){
       try{
         handle=await window.showSaveFilePicker({
            suggestedName:'Kaitserfings_mans_redaktors.html',            types:[{description:'Редактируемая HTML-презентация',accept:{'text/html':['.html']}}]
         });
         saveHandle=handle;updateButtonLabel();
         // Do not wait for IndexedDB before writing; file permissions may be transient.
         rememberHandle(handle);
       }catch(err){
         if(err && err.name==='AbortError'){showMessage('Сохранение отменено: файл не выбран.',true);return}
         // Safari, in-app previews, policy-limited contexts: fall back to file download.
         handle=null;
       }
     }
     const html=exportHTML(false);
     if(handle){
       try{
         const perm=typeof handle.queryPermission==='function'?await handle.queryPermission({mode:'readwrite'}):'granted';
         if(perm!=='granted' && typeof handle.requestPermission==='function'){
           const result=await handle.requestPermission({mode:'readwrite'});
           if(result!=='granted'){showMessage('Доступ к файлу не разрешён. Выбери сохранение снова.',true);return}
         }
         const output=await handle.createWritable();
         await output.write(html);
         await output.close();
         mode='disk';
       }catch(e){
         // Do NOT claim disk save if permission/write failed.
         saveHandle=null;updateButtonLabel();
         showMessage('Не удалось перезаписать файл; скачиваю новую HTML-копию.',true);
       }
     }
     if(mode!=='disk'){
       const data=new Blob([html],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'});
       saveFile(data,'Kaitserfings_mans_redaktors.html');
       mode='download';
     }
     // The editor's existing draft store is a useful extra backup, not the only save.
     try{await store(snapshot())}catch(e){}
     if(mode==='disk')showMessage('✓ Сохранено в «'+handle.name+'» — фотографии и тексты внутри HTML.');
     else showMessage('✓ HTML скачан. Открой последний файл из папки «Загрузки» для продолжения.');
   }catch(e){showMessage('Не удалось сохранить: '+(e?.message||String(e)),true)}
   finally{busy=false;for(const b of buttons){if(b)b.disabled=false}}
 }
 for(const button of buttons){if(button)button.addEventListener('click',savePresentation)}
 window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
   if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase()==='s'){
     e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();savePresentation();
   }
 },true);
 // File System Access handles are restored when the file remains under the same browser origin.
 restoreHandle();updateButtonLabel();
 for(const b of buttons){if(b)b.disabled=false}
})();
</script>

<script id="kite-final-behavior-fixes">
(function(){
'use strict';
function setup(){
  /* The built-in gear onclick already switches the equipment; block the extra album listener. */
  document.querySelectorAll('#gearBtns [data-gear]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if(typeof btn.onclick==='function')btn.onclick.call(btn,event);
    },true);
  });
  const gearPhoto=document.getElementById('gearPhoto');
  if(gearPhoto)gearPhoto.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();},true);
  /* Normalize the current wind display on initial render and after slider movement. */
  const speed=document.getElementById('speedSlider');
  const wind=document.getElementById('windSpeed');
  if(speed&&wind){
    const normalize=()=>{
      const unit=wind.querySelector('span');
      if(unit){unit.textContent='m/s';unit.removeAttribute('style')}
    };
    normalize();speed.addEventListener('input',()=>queueMicrotask(normalize));
  }
  /* Native HTML5 video: local MP4 or externally hosted direct MP4 URL. */
  const shell=document.getElementById('estoniaVideoShell');
  const player=document.getElementById('estoniaVideo');
  const placeholder=document.getElementById('estoniaEmpty');
  if(shell&&player&&placeholder){
    const input=document.getElementById('kiteMp4Url');
    const apply=document.getElementById('kiteMp4Apply');
    const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const userUrl=params.get('video');
    const localMp4='media/haademeeste.mp4';
    const hostedMp4='https://pub-8f2d8018add54d968bd19c5f379b1500.r2.dev/haademeeste.mp4';
    const showVideo=(src)=>{
      player.hidden=false;player.classList.add('kite-native');player.controls=true;
      player.playsInline=true;player.preload='metadata';player.src=src;
      placeholder.style.display='none';player.load();
    };
    player.addEventListener('error',()=>{
      player.classList.remove('kite-native');player.removeAttribute('src');
      placeholder.style.display='flex';
    });
    const validate=(url)=>{
      try{const u=new URL(url,location.href);return ['http:','https:'].includes(u.protocol)?u.href:null}catch(e){return null}
    };
    if(apply&&input){
      apply.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        let src=validate(input.value.trim());if(src&&!/\.mp4(?:$|[?#])/i.test(src))src=hostedMp4;if(!src){input.setCustomValidity('Ievadi derīgu https:// MP4 saiti');input.reportValidity();return}
        input.setCustomValidity('');showVideo(src);
        const address=new URL(location.href);address.searchParams.set('video',src);
        history.replaceState(null,'',address.toString());
      });
      input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')apply.click()});
    }
    // The hosted MP4 is the default; explicit ?video= URLs still take priority.
    // Legacy links sometimes contain only the R2 bucket root in ?video=.
    // Ignore those and prefer the actual MP4 object.
    const override=userUrl&&validate(userUrl);
    const chosen=(override&&/\.mp4(?:$|[?#])/i.test(override))?override:hostedMp4;
    if(input)input.value=chosen;
    if(override!==chosen&&params.has('video')){
      const cleaned=new URL(location.href);
      cleaned.searchParams.delete('video');
      history.replaceState(null,'',cleaned.toString());
    }
    showVideo(chosen);
  }
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',setup,{once:true});else setup();
})();
</script>
</body></html>
